scope: Automatic content-keyed system/media/browser Docker tool bases, editable recipe inputs, frozen per-build identities, and the existing single build entry.

implementation.recipeFiles: recipes/common/bases/ materialized as bases/plan.json, external Dockerfiles and scripts in each complete context
implementation.leafDependencies: Codex, gh, business pip/npm packages, Skills, MCP seed and profile lock remain in the leaf; final USER node is preserved.
implementation.identity: Parent image ID, platform, stage input bytes/execute permissions and effective per-stage source arguments determine reuse. Actual IDs are persisted in ImageBuild.baseImages and a separate per-job build-bases.lock.json without rewriting immutable context.zip.
implementation.queue: Base preparation runs inside the existing serial build job and log; no nested queued job or new UI entry.
implementation.rebuild: Historical rebuild retains recorded root/layer IDs, including when noCache is requested. Missing frozen IDs fail explicitly. New builds may recreate a confirmed-missing shared cache from their pinned parent and inputs.
implementation.rootRefresh: Local root image is reused; only confirmed absence triggers pull. New builds/noCache do not refresh remote mutable tags automatically.
implementation.repairCandidate: Kun RepairOf creates a new candidate context/chain; it may reuse matching cache but does not promise to inherit original actual base IDs. Original failure/context/IDs remain intact.
compatibility: Legacy contexts without a base plan keep their build behavior.
Standalone docker build uses the complete exported fallback installation.
Explicit Codex runtime base mode retains its existing frozen Codex parent and standalone tools path.
Complete-image pull/local acquisition does not build tool layers.
Managed tool-base builds use normal Docker layer cache rather than a whole-output shortcut with unrelated base provenance.
implementation.sources: Capabilities include the declared ancestor Dockerfiles; overrides are routed per layer, npm/pip changes do not enter tool-base keys. RD_TOOL_BASE_READY is reserved from source catalogs.
implementation.ui: Existing build details expose collapsed pinned base identities; setup preparation cards show completed base count.
implementation.dockerignore: All six closed allowlists include bases/. Regression validates every actual COPY input across all default/optional variants.

upgrade: Upgrade host source/executable and shipped recipes normally while preserving the existing data/configuration. Existing frozen recipes do not gain bases retroactively; start a new build from the updated managed recipe to use common layers.

limitations: No real Docker daemon image build, apt download, HyperFrames render, model/provider authentication or production Kun execution was performed here.
Public base images were not uploaded or published. Shared bases are prepared/reused locally in this release.
Debian packages and mutable Node references are not fully version-locked; actual built IDs are frozen, not a guarantee of byte-identical rebuild from arbitrary future package servers.
Windows was cross-compiled, not run natively. Browser visual layout was not tested.
No deployed server binary/image/data were modified, and previous Kun model-read/download timeout investigation is not claimed fixed by this change.
